correctness.rationale: Recomputed the implicit LMM coefficient substitution into y[n+2]=Ay[n+1]-By[n], discriminant Delta=4(1+k)^3[(1+k)-2(1-k)z]/[(3-k)(1+k)+2z]^2, and exact sign boundaries za=(1-k^2)/k, zb=(3k-1)(1+k)/(2k^2), zc=(1+k)/(2(1-k)). The identities zb-za=(1+k)^2(2k-1)/(2k^2), zc-zb=(1+k)(2k-1)^2/[2k^2(1-k)] give regime ordering. Roots solve the recurrence: for two nonnegative roots all-start ratios are w>=lambda_-, for A>=0,B<=0 all w>0, when A<0,B<0 the negative root dominates unless w=positive root, and conjugate nonreal roots eventually oscillate negative. A=B=0 at (k,z)=(1/2,3/2); sign-change derivatives give unique maximizer. Independent SymPy exact checks of 7 identities and representative numerical replays corroborated, not substitute for infinite-index root argument.
